definitions: The main body of a book, article, or other printed or written material, as distinct from illustrations, appendices, etc.
A book or other work produced for the study of a particular subject.
A passage from the Bible or other religious work, especially one chosen as the subject of a sermon.
examples: The pictures are an aid to the text.
She was studying a text by a Roman historian.
I'll send you a text when I'm on my way.
The sermon was based on a text from the Gospel of John.
